verdict_reason: Correct, well-tested immutable criteria record, but the SearchTerm type reuses 'search term' for a second concept and its Javadoc restates rules owned by AddressListQueryImpl and RequestedListFilters.

todos.issue: One name, two concepts: the sealed type SearchTerm (ListCriteria.java:22, field searchTerms:14) is any search clause — text, country or role — while 'search term' elsewhere in the same flow means only the user's text: RequestedListFilters.searchTerm (the q param, RequestedListFilters.java:10), AddressService.toPartialMatchRegex(String searchTerm) and the test list_passesTheSearchTermAsAPartialMatchPattern. In AddressService.searchTermsOf (:99-110) requested.searchTerm() and List<SearchTerm> searchTerms sit side by side and mean different things, and new InCountries(...) is added to 'searchTerms' though it is not a search term in the request's vocabulary.
todos.fix: Must: 'search term' names one concept across the request record, the service, ListCriteria and the tests. One way: rename the sealed type and its list to SearchClause/searchClauses (or SearchMatch/searchMatches), updating ListCriteria, AddressListQueryImpl.clausesOf, AddressService.searchTermsOf, AddressTestSupport and ListCriteriaTest titles and the IllegalArgumentException message; keep searchTerm for the user's q text.

todos.issue: Javadoc describes other modules' rules, not this record's lines. TextMatching (:25-26) lists the matched fields 'name, address lines, town or city, county or postcode' and 'case-insensitively' — both are owned by AddressListQueryImpl.clausesOf (Stream.of("name", "addressLine1", ... "postcode") ... regex(pattern, "i"), AddressListQueryImpl.java:55-56), so the field list now has two homes and the doc goes untrue the moment a field is added there. InCountries' '@param countryCodes trimmed, non-blank country codes' (:39) describes the normalisation RequestedListFilters does (RequestedListFilters.java:23-24); the record's constructor only checks non-empty, so the claim is not part of what this type guarantees.
todos.fix: Must: ListCriteria's Javadoc states only what the record itself guarantees, and the searched-field list and case rule live in one place (AddressListQueryImpl). One way: TextMatching -> 'Matches an address whose searchable text matches the pattern'; InCountries -> '@param countryCodes the country codes; never empty'.
